messages.subject: error message from stepwiseqtl
parts:
Hi folks:

I'm using the stepwiseqtl procedure to build multiple QTL models for a
number of phenotypes. Once in while (for some phenotypes, but not
all) I'm getting this error message.

Error in makeqtl(cross, as.character(out[wh, 1]), out[wh, 2], "Q1",
what = qtlmethod) :
Multiple markers at the same position; run jittermap.
Calls: stepwiseqtl -> makeqtl
Execution halted


We've previously run jittermap and have also used the
"inc.markers=FALSE" statement.
Has anyone else had this problem? or suggestions on what might be
happening?

Best,
Tom

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] error message from stepwiseqtl
parts:
Hi, Tom,

I'm not sure how this error could show up if you'd first run jittermap to ensure that there are markers are not on top of one another.

Does the problem arise consistently?

If you send me some data with code giving rise to the error, that would help me to figure out what's going on.

karl
